chain_rule: At most one newly approved case per task and seed 101-105 in protocol order; stop at first unsafe, unknown action, missing artifact, version drift or absent Service stop receipt. No substitution after a new chain begins.
decision: A fresh engineering chain needs a separately frozen review identity because both old seed-101 cases failed. Earlier cases and conclusions remain in their original freeze; none is replaced or counted in the new chain.
eligibility_rule: Engineering approval does not authorize formal_eligible=true, a 25-seed profile, held-out, or the seven-policy comparison. An independent admission audit remains required.
